name: oxly
displayName: Oxly — Chrome DevTools for AI Agents
description: Trace, cost, and security observability for AI agents. Phase 2: 6 project-scoped read-only MCP tools + live /mcp endpoint.

mcp.note: Phase 2 serves 6 read-only tools: query_traces, get_trace, get_span, query_security_alerts, cost_summary, whoami. Inspector must get init ok.

ui.note: Production UI assets MUST be hosted at the stable HTTPS origin allow-listed by the API Content-Security-Policy (frame-ancestors/script-src). Local dev serves packages/plugin/ui/ at /plugin/ui/.

auth.note: Every MCP tool takes the project's SDK API key (ak_...) as api_key and scopes to that project (explicit project_id must match). DEMO_MODE=true allows keyless calls with explicit project_id for local exploration.
